sell.hero.line2: and let great business be seen
sell.hero.body: Create a shop for free. Once approved you can list products and start selling.
sell.modes.title: A business model for every kind of seller
sell.modes.goods.label: I have products
sell.modes.goods.title: Good products sell themselves
sell.modes.goods.body: Turn your sourcing edge into shop sales. List products, manage stock and track orders — the essentials, all in one place.
sell.modes.live.label: I do live streams
sell.modes.live.title: If you can perform, you can sell
sell.modes.live.body: Put what you do on camera to work for sales. Your shop is where your audience lands — they can order right after watching.
sell.modes.original.label: I make original work
sell.modes.original.title: Original work deserves to be taken seriously
sell.modes.original.body: Handcraft, design and original content each have their own audience. Open a shop that is yours alone, and let people who get it find you.
sell.modes.factory.label: I run a factory
sell.modes.factory.title: From the workshop to the buyer
sell.modes.factory.body: Cut out the middleman and put great products in front of consumers. Invite team members to help run the shop, so collaboration is easier.
sell.steps.create.title: Create your shop
sell.steps.create.body: Sign in and fill in your shop details — submitting takes about a minute.
sell.steps.review.title: Platform review
sell.steps.review.body: We review every application, and you can see the result as soon as it is ready.
sell.steps.operate.title: Start selling
sell.steps.operate.body: List products and invite team members — your shop is open for business.
sell.finalCta.title: Ready to open your shop?
sell.finalCta.body: Create your first shop for free, starting with one good product.
